items.title: Tesla Pulls Model Y AWD Trim, Premium Sold Out for 2026 - BASENOR - Tesla Accessories
items.snippet: Tesla Pulls Model Y AWD Trim, Premium Sold Out for 2026 BASENOR - Tesla Accessories
items.summary: Tesla has removed the $41,990 Model Y AWD from its U.S. order page, leaving the $39,990 RWD as the entry model and the $49,990 Premium AWD as the cheapest all-wheel-drive version. Premium orders now show January–March 2027 delivery estimates; Tesla has not said whether the trim is gone for good.

items.title: Tesla FSD Supervised at NZ Expo: 5 Details That Matter - BASENOR - Tesla Accessories
items.snippet: Tesla FSD Supervised at NZ Expo: 5 Details That Matter BASENOR - Tesla Accessories
items.summary: Tesla Australia & New Zealand will offer FSD (Supervised) demo rides in a Model 3 RWD at the NZ EV & Tech Expo in Auckland on 13–15 November 2026. FSD has been subscription-only in New Zealand at NZ$159 a month since 31 March 2026, and Tesla’s September safety data cited 160 million km driven on it across Australia and New Zealand.

items.title: Elon Musk Could Announce Tesla-SpaceX Merger By December: Report - Investor's Business Daily
items.snippet: Elon Musk Could Announce Tesla-SpaceX Merger By December: Report Investor's Business Daily
items.summary: IBD relays Bloomberg’s report that Tesla and SpaceX could announce a merger as soon as December, with early 2027 also discussed, while boards and advisers work through terms and governance. No agreement has been reached, and a deal would likely need a separate Tesla shareholder vote.

items.title: SpaceX-Tesla Merger Could Come Soon: What Do Shareholders Get? - Yahoo Finance
items.snippet: SpaceX-Tesla Merger Could Come Soon: What Do Shareholders Get? Yahoo Finance
items.summary: Yahoo Finance looks at what Tesla and SpaceX holders might receive in a combination now reported to be progressing toward a possible December announcement. No exchange ratio or valuation has been agreed; reports say the talks centre on how many SpaceX shares Tesla investors would get.

items.title: Tesla Stock Best Run in a Year on SpaceX Merger Report - Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) - Benzinga
items.snippet: Tesla Stock Best Run in a Year on SpaceX Merger Report - Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) Benzinga
items.summary: Benzinga says Tesla shares posted their best five-day rally in more than a year, up about 16% since the 5 November close and adding roughly $218 billion of market value, as merger talks with SpaceX were reported to be progressing. A deal could be announced as early as December but may slip into early 2027.

items.title: SpaceX and Tesla advance merger talks toward potentially record-breaking deal: Report - CNBC
items.snippet: SpaceX and Tesla advance merger talks toward potentially record-breaking deal: Report CNBC
items.summary: CNBC reports on Bloomberg’s story that SpaceX and Tesla are advancing merger negotiations toward what would be the largest deal ever. Reports put the combined value at roughly $3.4–3.5 trillion, with a December announcement possible and early 2027 an alternative.

items.title: SpaceX and Tesla Talks on Record Merger Are Said to Progress - Bloomberg.com
items.snippet: SpaceX and Tesla Talks on Record Merger Are Said to Progress Bloomberg.com
items.summary: Bloomberg reports that Tesla and SpaceX are progressing in merger negotiations and could announce the biggest-ever deal as soon as December, though an announcement could slip into early 2027. Boards and advisers are working out the terms and the governance structure of the combined company, with ring-fencing Tesla’s China business from SpaceX’s defense work among the issues.

items.title: If You Want to Order a New Tesla Cybertruck, You’re Now Forced to Buy the $112K Cyberbeast - Car and Driver
items.snippet: If You Want to Order a New Tesla Cybertruck, You’re Now Forced to Buy the $112K Cyberbeast Car and Driver
items.summary: Tesla has removed the Dual Motor AWD and Premium AWD Cybertruck versions from its order site, leaving only the tri-motor Cyberbeast from $112,235 including order and destination fees. The change follows Musk’s plan to end Cybertruck production in 2027 to make room for Cybercab.

items.title: House Republican invites Musk to move Tesla HQ to Florida - The Hill
items.snippet: House Republican invites Musk to move Tesla HQ to Florida The Hill
items.summary: Rep. Carlos Giménez (R-Fla.) sent Elon Musk a letter inviting him to move Tesla’s headquarters from Austin to Florida, citing concerns about politically motivated investigations in Texas after the midterms. He pitched South Florida’s workforce, infrastructure and business climate; Tesla has not responded publicly.

items.title: SpaceX-Tesla merger: 3 things to know about Musk's control and the deal's size - qz.com
items.snippet: SpaceX-Tesla merger: 3 things to know about Musk's control and the deal's size qz.com
items.summary: Quartz notes that no terms have been agreed and that a combined SpaceX–Tesla would be worth about $3.5 trillion at current prices. Musk is excluded from the special committees but holds roughly 82% of SpaceX’s voting power and about 20% of Tesla, which reports say could leave him with around 56% voting control of a combined company.

items.title: Why SpaceX Stock Is Getting in the Way of a Tesla Merger - Barron's
items.snippet: Why SpaceX Stock Is Getting in the Way of a Tesla Merger Barron's
items.summary: Barron’s (paywalled) argues that SpaceX’s share price is complicating the terms of a stock-for-stock Tesla deal; a summary of the piece says it cites a “political discount” of up to 25% on SpaceX shares. A weaker SpaceX price means more SpaceX shares would have to be issued to Tesla holders.

items.title: If SpaceX and Tesla Merge, Here's What a $10,000 Investment in the Combined Company Could Be Worth by 2030 - The Motley Fool
items.snippet: If SpaceX and Tesla Merge, Here's What a $10,000 Investment in the Combined Company Could Be Worth by 2030 The Motley Fool
items.summary: The Motley Fool argues that a $10,000 stake in a combined SpaceX–Tesla is more likely to be worth less by 2030 than more, despite bullish scenarios. It says a roughly $3.5 trillion combined valuation is hard to justify given Tesla’s slow growth and both companies’ high multiples.

items.title: Tesla extending Cybertruck production through summer 2027 to clear backlog, Elon Musk says - CBS News
items.snippet: Tesla extending Cybertruck production through summer 2027 to clear backlog, Elon Musk says CBS News
items.summary: CBS reports Musk’s statement that Cybertruck production will continue through the end of summer 2027 to work through the order backlog, later than the mid-2027 wind-down he announced on 6 November. Tesla may still have to refund deposits for orders it cannot build before the line closes.

items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Forms Special Committee To Review Possible All Stock Merger - Yahoo Finance
items.snippet: Tesla (TSLA) Forms Special Committee To Review Possible All Stock Merger Yahoo Finance
items.summary: A Simply Wall St piece on Yahoo Finance notes that Tesla and SpaceX have each formed special committees of independent directors to evaluate a potential all-stock merger. It says the next proof point would be a deal framework with valuation, an exchange ratio and a separate vote for Tesla’s outside shareholders.

items.title: Shareholder letter: “Act Like the Owner You Are. Vote.”
items.summary: The Tesla Board asks shareholders to vote FOR re-electing Elon Musk, Robyn Denholm and JB Straubel and for all proposals at the 3 December 2026 annual meeting, noting that about 74% of outstanding shares voted last year. items.title: DEFA14A — additional proxy materials (digital ads)
items.summary: Tesla filed copies of 2 November digital and social advertisements telling shareholders “Your Board sets bold goals and delivers” and to vote for all three proposals before the 3 December meeting. No new financial information is included.

items.timeSource: Filed as DEFA14A, EDGAR accepted 2026-10-29 17:00:20 ET
items.title: Shareholder letter: “The Board that Created the Mission Are the Ones to Carry It Forward”
items.summary: The Board makes its case for re-electing its three Class I directors at the 3 Dec 2026 meeting (3:00 p.m. CT), pointing to the Robotaxi rollout, Cybercab, Optimus and the Terafab chip-supply initiative. It cites 1.74 million paid FSD (Supervised) customers with a ~75% attach rate on new North American deliveries in Q3 2026, TTM revenue above $100 billion and more than 10 million vehicles delivered.

items.title: DEFA14A — shareholder letter backing the Class I directors
items.summary: The filing carries the Board’s 29 October letter supporting the re-election of Musk, Denholm and Straubel and confirms the meeting time of 3:00 p.m. CT on 3 December 2026. It lists 1.74 million paid FSD customers and more than 10 million vehicles delivered as achievements.

items.title: SCHEDULE 13G/A — BlackRock reports 4.96% of Tesla
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. reported beneficial ownership of 196,348,742 Tesla shares, 4.96% of the class, as of 30 September 2026. The amendment states that no single person’s interest within the holding exceeds 5% of Tesla’s outstanding shares.

items.timeSource: EDGAR filing index: accepted 2026-10-21 20:12:41 ET (filing date 22 Oct)
items.title: 10-Q — quarter ended 30 Sep 2026
items.summary: The Q3 10-Q shows 3,952,757,946 shares outstanding on 15 October 2026, nine-month operating cash flow of $14.90 billion and capex of $13.01 billion. It also details Musk’s June exercise of ~304.0 million 2018-award options (net-settling ~17.5 million shares) into restricted shares that vest on 19 January 2028, and the 423.7 million-share 2025 CEO Performance Award.

items.title: Tesla Q3 2026 Update — financial results and outlook
items.summary: Tesla reported Q3 2026 revenue of $28.05 billion (flat year on year), GAAP operating income of $718 million, GAAP net income of $787 million and free cash flow of $1.53 billion, with cash and investments up $1.9 billion to $45.4 billion. It said Cybercab joined the Austin Robotaxi fleet on 3 September, Optimus production began in Fremont, Megafactory Texas started production and active FSD subscriptions reached 1.74 million.

items.title: 8-K — Items 2.02 and 9.01, Q3 2026 results (Update deck as Exhibit 99.1)
items.summary: Tesla furnished its Q3 2026 Update as Exhibit 99.1, reporting $28.05 billion revenue, 19.6% GAAP gross margin, 2.6% operating margin and $1.53 billion free cash flow. The deck also lists 8,904 Supercharger stations, 1.74 million active FSD subscriptions and more than 225 MW of Cortex training compute.

items.title: DEF 14A — 2026 annual meeting proxy statement
items.summary: The definitive proxy sets the 2026 annual meeting for 3 December at Gigafactory Texas, with three items: electing Musk, Denholm and Straubel, an advisory say-on-pay vote and ratifying PwC as auditor. It also introduces the Voluntary Retail Voting Program for future meetings.

items.title: Tesla Third Quarter 2026 Production, Deliveries & Deployments
items.summary: Tesla produced 464,391 vehicles, delivered 486,532 and deployed 13.7 GWh of energy storage in Q3 2026, with Model 3/Y accounting for 478,237 deliveries and other models 8,295. Deliveries beat the ~462,000 company-compiled consensus but were about 2% below Q3 2025’s 497,099.

items.title: 8-K — Q3 2026 production, deliveries and deployments
items.summary: Tesla furnished its Q3 2026 volume release: 464,391 vehicles produced, 486,532 delivered and 13.7 GWh of storage deployed. About 1% of deliveries were subject to operating-lease accounting.

items.title: 8-K — $30 billion of new unsecured credit facilities
items.summary: Tesla entered a $20.0 billion three-year delayed-draw term loan, an $8.0 billion five-year revolver and a $2.0 billion 364-day revolver, replacing a $5.0 billion 2023 revolver. Nothing was drawn at signing, the agreements require at least $5.0 billion of liquidity, and Tesla said it does not plan to draw on them in 2026.
